item.title: About
item.description:
I build algorithmic trading systems and test whether they work.

Currently running a market-neutral statistical arbitrage bot on Hyperliquid, and researching microstructure edges between crypto order flow and Kalshi event contracts.

This site is where I publish the honest version of what I test — including the ~90% of ideas that don’t work.

Contact: andy@deltoro.dev
